analysis|09-04|1870|Ανακηρύσσεται η Τρίτη Γαλλική Δημοκρατία|The Third French Republic is proclaimed|On 4 September 1870, after France's defeat at Sedan and the capture of Napoleon III, the Parisians proclaimed the republic. The imperial government collapsed within a few hours, and a provisional government of national defense was formed. The capital, besieged by the Prussians, wanted to continue the resistance. // The new government announced the Third Republic, without the form of the state having yet been formally determined. The proclamation was an expression of popular anger at the defeat, but also of the wish for a system that would lose the imperial form. Jules Favre and other politicians led the transition. // The Third Republic lasted until 1940 and shaped the modern political life of France, with a parliamentary system and a strong role for citizens. analysis|09-07|1812|Η μάχη του Μποροντίνο|The Battle of Borodino|In 1812 Napoleon had invaded Russia with a huge army, with the aim of forcing the Tsar to submit to the blockade of Britain.
